title: Automated Product Catalog Animation
business: E-commerce retailers needing to convert static product photography into engaging video content for social media marketing.
problem: Manual video production for thousands of individual product SKUs is prohibitively expensive and slow, creating a bottleneck in seasonal marketing campaigns.
solution: Using the Wan 2.2 ComfyUI Repackaged model, retailers can automate the transformation of static high-resolution product images into short, fluid video clips that demonstrate product features or textures without manual filming.
steps: Download the required Wan 2.2 I2V 14B model files and place them into the ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models directory.
Configure the ComfyUI workflow to load the UMT5 text encoder and the specific Wan 2.2 VAE for image processing.
Input the static product image and a descriptive text prompt into the I2V node to guide the animation style.
Execute the graph to generate the video clip, ensuring the VAE correctly decodes the latent representation into a video file.
outcome: A scalable pipeline that generates consistent, high-quality video assets from existing image libraries, significantly reducing time-to-market for digital campaigns.
limitation: The model requires substantial VRAM for the 14B parameter variant, which may lead to out-of-memory errors on consumer-grade hardware; users should check their GPU memory capacity before attempting high-resolution generation.
